          return if @kick == 'none' || @kh <= 0
          @segs.each do |sg|
            if @sides_low
              # pedestal sides that run to the floor: the base fits between them
              x0 = sg['c0'] > 0 && @knee_all ? sg['x0'] : sg['x0'] - @t
              x1 = sg['c1'] < @cols.size - 1 && @knee_all ? sg['x1'] : sg['x1'] + @t
            else
              x0 = @cx0
              x1 = @cx1
            end
            ny = @notch
            case @kick
            when 'integral'
              panel('Toe kick', 'base', @mk, x0, x1, ny - @t, ny, 0, @kh, 'y', 'x', '')
            when 'plinth'
              panel('Plinth front', 'base', @mk, x0, x1, ny - @t, ny, 0, @kh, 'y', 'x', '')
              panel('Plinth back', 'base', @mk, x0, x1, @side_back - @t, @side_back, 0, @kh, 'y', 'x', '')
              span = x1 - x0
              n_int = [(span / 600.0).ceil - 1, 0].max
              xs = [x0]
              (1..n_int).each { |k| xs << x0 + span * k / (n_int + 1) - @t / 2.0 }
              xs << x1 - @t
              xs.each do |px|
                panel('Plinth rail', 'base', @mk, px, px + @t, ny, @side_back - @t, 0, @kh, 'x', 'y', '')
              end
            when 'legs'
              # The clip-on toe kick for legs is bought by length, not cut from board: it is
              # neither drawn nor in the cut list — only in hardware and the 4 m bar plan.
              hw("Plastic toe kick, stainless look, #{fmt @kh} mm high: #{fmt x1 - x0} mm", 1)
              unless Params::KICK_PLASTIC_H.any? { |h| (h - @kh).abs < 0.05 }
                warn("The plastic toe kick comes 100 or 150 mm high — set the toe kick height to one of them (now #{fmt @kh} mm).")
              end
              span = x1 - x0
              n_x = [(span / 900.0).ceil + 1, 2].max
              xs = (0...n_x).map { |k| x0 + 40 + (span - 80) * k / (n_x - 1) }
              ys = [ny + 40, @side_back - 40]
              xs.each do |lx|
                ys.each { |ly| cyl('Adjustable leg', Params::METAL, [lx, ly, 0], 'z', 15, @kh) }
              end
              hw("Adjustable leg, #{fmt @kh} mm", xs.size * ys.size)
              hw('Toe-kick clip', [xs.size, 2].max)
            end
          end
        end

        # Decorative top, laid on the carcass (outside the module height). With decorative
        # side panels it either covers them (side overhang measured from their outer face)
        # or sits nested between them.
        def worktop
          return unless @add_top
          oh_s = f('top_oh_sides')
          between = s('top_skin_mode') == 'between'
          x0 = @sl > 0 ? (between ? 0.0 : -@sl - oh_s) : -oh_s
          x1 = @sr > 0 ? (between ? @W : @W + @sr + oh_s) : @W + oh_s
          panel('Top (solid)', 'top', @mt, x0, x1, -f('top_oh_front'), @D + f('top_oh_back'), @H, @H + @top_t, 'z', 'x', '2L 2W')
        end

        # ------------------------------------------------------------------ decorative side panels
        def skins
          back_skin
          return if @sl <= 0 && @sr <= 0
          y0 = @p['skin_front_flush'] ? (@inset ? 0.0 : -@ft) : -f('skin_front')
          y1 = @D + f('skin_back')
          z0, z1 = skin_z
          floor = z0 <= 0.05
          eb = floor ? '1L 2W' : '1L 1W' # front edge + top edge (+ floor edge)
          note = floor ? 'decorative; banded front, top and floor edges' : 'decorative; banded front and top edges'
          ms = s('mat_skin')
          { 'L' => [-@sl, 0.0, @sl], 'R' => [@W, @W + @sr, @sr] }.each do |side, (a, b, th)|
            next if th <= 0
            prism("Decorative side #{side}", 'skin', ms, 'x', a, b - a,
                  [[y0, z0], [y1, z0], [y1, z1], [y0, z1]], 'z', eb, 'note' => note)
          end
        end

        # Decorative back (a back that is seen, e.g. an island): behind the carcass — behind the
        # rear edge of the decorative side panels when there are any — across the whole width,
        # same height as the side panels. Outside the module depth, like the decorative top.
        def back_skin
          return unless @p['skin_b']
          th = f('skin_t')
          return if th <= 0
          y = @D + (@sl > 0 || @sr > 0 ? f('skin_back') : 0.0)
          z0, z1 = skin_z
          floor = z0 <= 0.05
          both = @sl > 0 && @sr > 0
          eb = [floor ? '2L' : '1L', both ? nil : (@sl > 0 || @sr > 0 ? '1W' : '2W')].compact.join(' ')
          note = 'decorative back' + (floor ? '; to the floor' : '')
          panel('Decorative back', 'skin', s('mat_skin'), -@sl, @W + @sr, y, y + th, z0, z1, 'y', 'x', eb, 'note' => note)
        end

        # Top, bottom and back that are seen (an island, a wall cabinet from below, an open back)
        # take the visible-end material, like visible sides — unless a decorative panel covers them.
        def visible_faces
          vis = { 'Top' => @p['end_top'] && !@add_top, 'Bottom' => @p['end_bottom'], 'Back' => @p['end_back'] && !@p['skin_b'] }
          return unless vis.values.any?
          me = s('mat_end')
          @parts.each do |pt|
            key = pt['name'] =~ /\ABack( \d+)?\z/ && pt['role'] == 'back' ? 'Back' : pt['name']
            next unless pt['role'] != 'skin' && vis[key]
            pt['mat'] = me
            pt['note'] = [pt['note'], 'visible'].compact.join('; ')
          end
        end

        # Applied back: from the carcass bottom (or the floor) up to the carcass top, or to a
        # height of its own — kept within the module height unless it may go past it.
        def applied_back_z
          zb = @p['back_floor'] ? 0.0 : @bottom_under
          zt = @top
          if @p['back_hset'] && f('back_h') > 0
            zt = zb + f('back_h')
            if zt > @top + 0.05 && !@p['back_over']
              warn("The back is #{fmt f('back_h')} mm high — only #{fmt(@top - zb)} mm fit within the module height; tick “may go past the module height” to keep it.")
              zt = @top
            end
          end
          [zb, zt]
        end

        # Bottom and top of the decorative side / back panels.
        def skin_z
          base = if @sides_low
                   %w[integral none].include?(@kick) ? 0.0 : @base_z
                 else
                   @bottom_under
                 end
          z0 = @p['skin_floor'] ? 0.0 : [base - f('skin_bottom'), 0.0].max
          between = s('top_skin_mode') == 'between'
          z1 = if @add_top && !between then @H
               elsif @add_top then @H + @top_t + (@p['skin_top_flush'] ? 0.0 : f('skin_top'))
               else @H + f('skin_top')
               end
          [z0, z1]
        end

        # Move everything right by dx (decorative panels inside the module width).
        def shift_x(dx)
          @parts.each do |pt|
            if pt['shape'] == 'cyl'
              pt['center'][0] = r(pt['center'][0] + dx)
            elsif pt['axis'] == 'x'
              pt['pos'] = r(pt['pos'] + dx)
            else
              pt['pts'] = pt['pts'].map { |q| [r(q[0] + dx), q[1]] }
            end
            (pt['grooves'] || []).each { |ln| ln.each { |q| q[0] = r(q[0] + dx) } }
            pt['slide']['face_x'] = r(pt['slide']['face_x'] + dx) if pt['slide'] # slide model placement
            if pt['hinge']                                                        # hinge model placement
              pt['hinge']['x'] = r(pt['hinge']['x'] + dx)
              pt['hinge']['side_x'] = r(pt['hinge']['side_x'] + dx) if pt['hinge']['side_x']
            end
          end
          @movers.each do |m|
            m['pivot'][0] = r(m['pivot'][0] + dx) if m['pivot']
            m['at'][0] = r(m['at'][0] + dx) if m['at']
          end
        end

        # ------------------------------------------------------------------ blind corner
        # Seen from the front, from the outer edge on the blind side:
        #   blind panel — covers the module on the other wall (its depth + its front) plus the
        #                 clearance, or a width you give, or whatever a given door width leaves
        #   door(s)     — the opening; the door overlays a hinge divider like a side panel
        # The hinge divider stands behind the door edge, perpendicular to the front.
        # The clearance strip stands perpendicular to the blind panel at the other module's
        # carcass edge (behind its doors): that module butts against it and is held away by
        # the strip's width, so doors and handles don't clash in the corner.
        def setup_corner
          @cn = nil
          side = s('corner')
          return if side == 'none'
          if @ff
            warn('Blind corners are built for frameless cabinets — with a face frame use a wide stile instead.')
            return
          end
          col = side == 'left' ? @cols.first : @cols.last
          return if col.nil? || col['knee']
          left = side == 'left'
          m = ->(x) { left ? x : @W - x }               # "distance from the blind edge" → module x
          nb = f('corner_nb_depth')
          clear = [f('corner_clear'), 0.0].max
          # far door edge of this column, measured from the blind edge
          a = col['first'] ? 0.0 : col['cl']
          b = col['last'] ? @W : col['cr']
          far = left ? front_edge(b, col['last'], -1, :x, @t, true) : @W - front_edge(a, col['first'], 1, :x, @t, true)
          door_from_edge = case s('corner_size')
                           when 'blind' then f('corner_blind_w') + @gap / 2.0
                           when 'door' then far - f('corner_door_w')
                           else nb + @ft + clear + @gap / 2.0
                           end
          blind_end = door_from_edge - @gap / 2.0
          over = front_edge(0.0, true, 1, :x, @t, true) # a door edge's distance from a side's outer face
          dx0 = door_from_edge - over                   # divider face on the blind side
          dx1 = dx0 + @t
          inner = left ? col['x0'] : @W - col['x1']
          if dx0 < inner + 20
            warn("Blind corner: the blind section (#{fmt blind_end} mm) is too narrow for a hinge divider.")
            return
          end
          opening = far - door_from_edge
          raise BuildError, "Blind corner: the door would be only #{fmt opening} mm wide (blind section #{fmt blind_end} mm) — widen the module or narrow the blind side." if opening < 150
          if clear > 0 && nb > blind_end - 1
            warn("Blind corner: the module on the other wall (#{fmt nb} mm deep) reaches past the blind panel (#{fmt blind_end} mm) — widen the blind side.")
          end
          @cn = {
            'side' => side, 'col' => col, 'clear' => clear, 'nb' => nb,
            'door_x' => m.(door_from_edge), 'blind_x' => [m.(0.0), m.(blind_end)].sort,
            'strip_x' => [m.(nb - @t), m.(nb)].sort,
            'div_x0' => [m.(dx0), m.(dx1)].min, 'div_x1' => [m.(dx0), m.(dx1)].max,
            'div_y0' => @y_int_front, 'div_y1' => @y_int_front + f('corner_div_w'),
            'opening' => opening, 'blind_w' => blind_end
          }
          if left then col['hx0'] = @cn['div_x1']
          else col['hx1'] = @cn['div_x0']
          end
        end

        def corner_parts
          return unless @cn
          c = @cn['col']
          slots = c['slots']
          z0 = front_edge(slots.last['z0'], true, 1, :z, @t, @divider)
          z1 = front_edge(slots.first['z1'], true, -1, :z, @top_edge, @divider) - @ct_drop
          y0, y1 = @inset ? [0.0, @ft] : [-@ft, 0.0]
          bx0, bx1 = @cn['blind_x']
          if @cn['side'] == 'left' then bx0 = front_edge(0.0, true, 1, :x, @t, true)
          else bx1 = front_edge(@W, true, -1, :x, @t, true)
          end
          panel('Blind panel', 'front', s('mat_front'), bx0, bx1, y0, y1, z0, z1, 'y', 'z', '2L 2W',
                'note' => "fixed; the module on the other wall (#{fmt @cn['nb']} mm deep) stands in front of it")
          if @cn['clear'] >= 1
            sx0, sx1 = @cn['strip_x']
            face = @inset ? 0.0 : -@ft
            panel('Corner filler', 'front', s('mat_front'), sx0, sx1, face - @cn['clear'], face, z0, z1, 'x', 'z', '2L 1W',
                  'note' => "perpendicular to the blind panel at the other module's carcass edge; holds it #{fmt @cn['clear']} mm away")
            # a second one at the outer (wall) edge, so the other module rests on two points
            ox0, ox1 = @cn['side'] == 'left' ? [0.0, @t] : [@W - @t, @W]
            panel('Corner filler', 'front', s('mat_front'), ox0, ox1, face - @cn['clear'], face, z0, z1, 'x', 'z', '2L 1W',
                  'note' => "perpendicular to the blind panel at the outer edge; second contact for the other module (#{fmt @cn['clear']} mm)")
          end
          panel('Hinge divider', 'carcass', @mc, @cn['div_x0'], @cn['div_x1'], @cn['div_y0'], @cn['div_y1'],
                @bottom_top, @top_under, 'x', 'z', '2L', 'note' => 'hinges screw onto it; fixed to bottom and top')
          hw('Connector bracket for blind panel and fillers', @cn['clear'] >= 1 ? 3 : 2)
        end

        # ------------------------------------------------------------------ face frame
        def ff_open_x(c)
          a = c['first'] ? 0.0 : c['cl']
          b = c['last'] ? @W : c['cr']
          [a + (c['first'] ? @st : @mid / 2.0), b - (c['last'] ? @st : @mid / 2.0)]
        end

        def ff_open_z(sl)
          [sl['z0'] + (sl['last'] ? @rail : @mid / 2.0), sl['z1'] - (sl['first'] ? @rail : @mid / 2.0)]
        end

        def face_frame
          fz0 = @base_z
          fz1 = @top
          panel('FF stile', 'frame', @mff, 0, @st, 0, @fft, fz0, fz1, 'y', 'z')
          panel('FF stile', 'frame', @mff, @W - @st, @W, 0, @fft, fz0, fz1, 'y', 'z')
          panel('FF top rail', 'frame', @mff, @st, @W - @st, 0, @fft, fz1 - @rail, fz1, 'y', 'x')
          @segs.each do |sg|
            c0 = @cols[sg['c0']]
            c1 = @cols[sg['c1']]
            bx0 = c0['first'] ? @st : c0['cl'] + @mid / 2.0
            bx1 = c1['last'] ? @W - @st : c1['cr'] - @mid / 2.0
            panel('FF bottom rail', 'frame', @mff, bx0, bx1, 0, @fft, fz0, fz0 + @rail, 'y', 'x')
          end
          @cols.each_with_index do |c, i|
            next if c['last']
            cc = c['cr']
            knee_adj = c['knee'] || @cols[i + 1]['knee']
            z0 = knee_adj ? fz0 : fz0 + @rail
            panel('FF mid stile', 'frame', @mff, cc - @mid / 2.0, cc + @mid / 2.0, 0, @fft, z0, fz1 - @rail, 'y', 'z')
          end
          if @cols.any? { |c| !c['knee'] && (c['first'] && @st > @cx0 + @t + 0.5 || c['last'] && @st > @W - @cx1 + @t + 0.5) }
            @stile_proud = true
          end
          @cols.each do |c|
            next if c['knee']
            ox0, ox1 = ff_open_x(c)
            c['slots'].each do |sl|
              next if sl['last']
              seam = sl['z0']
              panel('FF mid rail', 'frame', @mff, ox0, ox1, 0, @fft, seam - @mid / 2.0, seam + @mid / 2.0, 'y', 'x')
            end
          end
        end

        # ------------------------------------------------------------------ fronts
        # Position of a front edge. dir = +1 for a low edge, -1 for a high edge.
        def front_edge(boundary, outer, dir, axis, edge_thk, has_divider)
          if @ff
            open = boundary + dir * (outer ? (axis == :x ? @st : @rail) : @mid / 2.0)
            return @inset ? open + dir * @ffg : open - dir * @ffo
          end
          case @overlay
          when 'inset'
            if outer then boundary + dir * (edge_thk + @gap)
            elsif has_divider then boundary + dir * (@t / 2.0 + @gap)
            else boundary + dir * @gap / 2.0
            end
          when 'half'
            outer ? boundary + dir * (edge_thk / 2.0 + @gap / 2.0) : boundary + dir * @gap / 2.0
          else
            outer ? boundary + dir * @rev : boundary + dir * @gap / 2.0
          end
        end

        def front_rect(c, sl)
          a = c['first'] ? 0.0 : c['cl']
          b = c['last'] ? @W : c['cr']
          x0 = front_edge(a, c['first'], 1, :x, @t, true)
          x1 = front_edge(b, c['last'], -1, :x, @t, true)
          if @cn && c.equal?(@cn['col'])
            # blind corner: the fronts start past the blind panel and the clearance strip
            if @cn['side'] == 'left' then x0 = @cn['door_x']
            else x1 = @cn['door_x']
            end
          end
          z0 = front_edge(sl['z0'], sl['last'], 1, :z, @t, sl.fetch('div_lo', @divider))
          z1 = front_edge(sl['z1'], sl['first'], -1, :z, @top_edge, sl.fetch('div_hi', @divider))
          z1 -= @ct_drop if sl['first'] # clearance under a dropped countertop edge (e.g. double bullnose)
          [x0, x1, z0, z1]
        end

        def hinge_name
          if @ff
            @inset ? 'Concealed hinge, soft-close, face-frame inset' : 'Concealed hinge, soft-close, face-frame overlay'
          else
            case @overlay
            when 'inset' then 'Concealed hinge 110°, soft-close, inset arm (e.g. Blum CLIP top BLUMOTION)'
            when 'half' then 'Concealed hinge 110°, soft-close, half-overlay arm (e.g. Blum CLIP top BLUMOTION)'
            else 'Concealed hinge 110°, soft-close, full-overlay arm (e.g. Blum CLIP top BLUMOTION)'
            end
          end
        end

        def hinge_count(h)
          if h <= 900 then 2
          elsif h <= 1600 then 3
          elsif h <= 2000 then 4
          else 5
          end
        end

        def make_front(base, kind, x0, x1, z0, z1, tag, extra = {})
          w = x1 - x0
          h = z1 - z0
          if w < 40 || h < 40
            warn("#{tag}: #{base.downcase} is too small (#{fmt w}×#{fmt h} mm) — check sizes and gaps.")
            return
          end
          return glass_front(x0, x1, z0, z1, tag, extra) if @glass && kind == :door
          y0, y1 = @inset ? [0.0, @ft] : [-@ft, 0.0]
          grain = kind == :drawer ? 'x' : 'z'
          extra = extra.merge('tag' => tag)
          case s('front_style')
          when 'shaker'
            sw = f('shaker_w')
            if w > 2 * sw + 40 && h > 2 * sw + 40
              pt = f('shaker_panel_t')
              panel("#{base} stile", 'front', @mf, x0, x0 + sw, y0, y1, z0, z1, 'y', 'z', '', extra)
              panel("#{base} stile", 'front', @mf, x1 - sw, x1, y0, y1, z0, z1, 'y', 'z', '', extra)
              panel("#{base} rail", 'front', @mf, x0 + sw, x1 - sw, y0, y1, z0, z0 + sw, 'y', 'x', '', extra)
              panel("#{base} rail", 'front', @mf, x0 + sw, x1 - sw, y0, y1, z1 - sw, z1, 'y', 'x', '', extra)
              panel("#{base} panel", 'front', @mf, x0 + sw - 8, x1 - sw + 8, y1 - 4 - pt, y1 - 4, z0 + sw - 8, z1 - sw + 8,
                    'y', grain, '', extra.merge('note' => 'includes 8 mm tongue each side'))
              return
            end
            panel(base, 'front', @mf, x0, x1, y0, y1, z0, z1, 'y', grain, '2L 2W', extra.merge('note' => 'slab — too small for shaker'))
          when 'plank'
            vertical = s('plank_dir') == 'vertical'
            span = vertical ? w : h
            pg = f('plank_gap')
            n = [(span / f('plank_w')).round, 1].max
            pw = (span - (n - 1) * pg) / n
            (0...n).each do |k|
              a = (vertical ? x0 : z0) + k * (pw + pg)
              if vertical
                panel("#{base} plank", 'front', @mf, a, a + pw, y0, y1, z0, z1, 'y', 'z', '2L 2W', extra)
              else
                panel("#{base} plank", 'front', @mf, x0, x1, y0, y1, a, a + pw, 'y', 'x', '2L 2W', extra)
              end
            end
          when 'grooved'
            vertical = s('plank_dir') == 'vertical'
            span = vertical ? w : h
            n = [(span / f('plank_w')).round, 1].max
            grooves = (1...n).map do |k|
              q = (vertical ? x0 : z0) + span * k / n
              vertical ? [[r(q), r(z0)], [r(q), r(z1)]] : [[r(x0), r(q)], [r(x1), r(q)]]
            end
            panel(base, 'front', @mf, x0, x1, y0, y1, z0, z1, 'y', grain, '2L 2W',
                  extra.merge('grooves' => grooves, 'note' => "#{n - 1} decorative V-grooves"))
          else
            panel(base, 'front', @mf, x0, x1, y0, y1, z0, z1, 'y', grain, '2L 2W', extra)
          end
        end

        # ------------------------------------------------------------------ pulls
        PULL_MATS = { 'black' => 'PanelPro Pull Black', 'stainless' => 'PanelPro Pull Stainless',
                      'aluminium' => 'PanelPro Pull Aluminium', 'gold' => 'PanelPro Pull Gold' }.freeze

        # A front plus its pull. who: :door / :drawer (which pull settings); hinge: 'L' / 'R'
        # for side-hung doors (corners are named from the hinge), nil for drawers and flaps.
        # A full-length profile takes its height off the panel, so panel + profile = the front.
        def front_with_pull(who, base, kind, x0, x1, z0, z1, tag, extra, hinge)
          type = s("#{who}_pull")
          if type == 'none' || x1 - x0 < 60 || z1 - z0 < 60
            make_front(base, kind, x0, x1, z0, z1, tag, extra)
            return
          end
          corner = s("#{who}_pull_corner")
          meeting = who == :door && hinge && @pull_v && corner != 'center'
          if meeting
            # keep hinge side / opening side as chosen, put it at the end facing the joint
            hinge_side = %w[A C].include?(corner)
            corner = @pull_v == :top ? (hinge_side ? 'A' : 'B') : (hinge_side ? 'C' : 'D')
          end
          ref = pull_corner(corner, x0, x1, z0, z1, hinge)
          edge = corner == 'center' ? 'h' : (meeting && type == 'wedge' ? 'v' : s("#{who}_pull_edge"))
          mv = extra['mover'] ? { 'mover' => extra['mover'] } : {}
          mat = PULL_MATS[s('pull_finish')] || PULL_MATS['black']
          fin = s('pull_finish')
          yf = @inset ? 0.0 : -@ft # the front's face
          yb = yf + @ft
          if type == 'profile'
            h = [f('profile_h'), 5.0].max
            px0, px1, pz0, pz1 = x0, x1, z0, z1
            side = if edge == 'h' then ref[:top] ? :top : :bottom
                   else ref[:left] ? :left : :right
                   end
            case side
            when :top then pz1 -= h
            when :bottom then pz0 += h
            when :left then px0 += h
            else px1 -= h
            end
            if px1 - px0 < 40 || pz1 - pz0 < 40
              warn("#{tag}: the #{fmt h} mm pull profile leaves too little front.")
              make_front(base, kind, x0, x1, z0, z1, tag, extra)
              return
            end
            make_front(base, kind, px0, px1, pz0, pz1, tag,
                       extra.merge('note' => [extra['note'], "+ #{fmt h} mm #{side} pull profile"].compact.join('; ')))
            pull_profile(side, x0, x1, z0, z1, h, yf, yb, mat, mv)
            len = %i[top bottom].include?(side) ? x1 - x0 : z1 - z0
            hw("Pull profile #{fmt h} mm, #{fin}, #{fmt len} mm long", 1)
            return
          end
          make_front(base, kind, x0, x1, z0, z1, tag, extra)
          if type == 'tbar'
            pull_tbar(who, ref, corner, x0, x1, z0, z1, yf, mat, mv, tag)
            hw("T-bar pull Ø#{fmt f('tbar_d')}, #{fmt f('tbar_cc')} mm centres, #{fmt f('tbar_len')} mm, #{fin}", 1)
          else
            pull_wedge(who, ref, corner, edge, x0, x1, z0, z1, yf, mat, mv, tag)
            hw("Edge (wedge) pull #{fmt f('wedge_len')} mm, #{fin}", 1)
          end
        end

        # The corner's position and which way "into the front" is from it.
        def pull_corner(corner, x0, x1, z0, z1, hinge)
          return { x: (x0 + x1) / 2.0, z: z1, sx: 1, sz: -1, top: true, left: false, center: true } if corner == 'center'
          tl = { 'A' => [true, true], 'B' => [true, false], 'C' => [false, true], 'D' => [false, false] }[corner]
          top, hinge_side = tl
          # door: A/C on the hinge side; drawers and flaps: A/C on the left
          left = hinge == 'R' ? !hinge_side : hinge_side
          { x: left ? x0 : x1, z: top ? z1 : z0, sx: left ? 1 : -1, sz: top ? -1 : 1, top: top, left: left, center: false }
        end

        def pull_tbar(who, ref, corner, x0, x1, z0, z1, yf, mat, mv, tag)
          rad = f('tbar_d') / 2.0
          len = f('tbar_len')
          off = [f('tbar_off'), f('tbar_d') + 5].max
          yc = yf - off + rad            # bar axis, in front of the face
          orient = corner == 'center' ? 'h' : s("#{who}_pull_orient")
          gx = f("#{who}_pull_gx")
          gy = f("#{who}_pull_gy")
          if orient == 'v'
            cx = corner == 'center' ? (x0 + x1) / 2.0 : ref[:x] + ref[:sx] * (gx + rad)
            za = corner == 'center' ? (z0 + z1 - len) / 2.0 : [ref[:z] + ref[:sz] * gy, ref[:z] + ref[:sz] * (gy + len)].min
            cyl('T-bar pull', mat, [cx, yc, za], 'z', rad, len, mv)
            mid = za + len / 2.0
            [mid - f('tbar_cc') / 2.0, mid + f('tbar_cc') / 2.0].each { |zp| cyl('T-bar post', mat, [cx, yc, zp], 'y', rad * 0.7, yf - yc, mv) }
            warn("#{tag}: the T-bar (#{fmt len} mm) is longer than the front.") if len > z1 - z0 - 10
          else
            cz = corner == 'center' ? (z0 + z1) / 2.0 : ref[:z] + ref[:sz] * (gy + rad)
            xa = corner == 'center' ? (x0 + x1 - len) / 2.0 : [ref[:x] + ref[:sx] * gx, ref[:x] + ref[:sx] * (gx + len)].min
            cyl('T-bar pull', mat, [xa, yc, cz], 'x', rad, len, mv)
            mid = xa + len / 2.0
            [mid - f('tbar_cc') / 2.0, mid + f('tbar_cc') / 2.0].each { |xp| cyl('T-bar post', mat, [xp, yc, cz], 'y', rad * 0.7, yf - yc, mv) }
            warn("#{tag}: the T-bar (#{fmt len} mm) is wider than the front.") if len > x1 - x0 - 10
          end
        end

        # L-shaped pull on an edge: a plate on the edge and a lip down over the face.
        # Wedge / edge pull: a flange screwed to the BACK face of the front (lip), and a plate
        # over the edge that runs forward past the front face (dep from the back, + t).
        def pull_wedge(who, ref, corner, edge, x0, x1, z0, z1, yf, mat, mv, tag)
          len = f('wedge_len')
          dep = [f('wedge_depth'), 5.0].max
          lip = [f('wedge_lip'), 0.0].max
          gap = f("#{who}_pull_gap")
          t = 2.0
          yb = yf + @ft                 # back face of the front
          e0 = yb + t - dep             # plate: from the front (proud of the face) …
          e1 = yb + t                   # … to just behind the back face
          extra = mv.merge('cut' => false)
          if edge == 'h'
            a = ref[:center] ? (x0 + x1 - len) / 2.0 : [ref[:x] + ref[:sx] * gap, ref[:x] + ref[:sx] * (gap + len)].min
            b = a + len
            warn("#{tag}: the edge pull (#{fmt len} mm) is longer than the front.") if len > x1 - x0
            if ref[:top]
              panel('Edge pull', 'hardware', mat, a, b, e0, e1, z1, z1 + t, 'z', 'x', '', extra)
              panel('Edge pull lip', 'hardware', mat, a, b, yb, yb + t, z1 - lip, z1, 'y', 'x', '', extra) if lip > 0.5
            else
              panel('Edge pull', 'hardware', mat, a, b, e0, e1, z0 - t, z0, 'z', 'x', '', extra)
              panel('Edge pull lip', 'hardware', mat, a, b, yb, yb + t, z0, z0 + lip, 'y', 'x', '', extra) if lip > 0.5
            end
          else
            a = [ref[:z] + ref[:sz] * gap, ref[:z] + ref[:sz] * (gap + len)].min
            b = a + len
            warn("#{tag}: the edge pull (#{fmt len} mm) is longer than the front.") if len > z1 - z0
            if ref[:left]
              panel('Edge pull', 'hardware', mat, x0 - t, x0, e0, e1, a, b, 'x', 'z', '', extra)
              panel('Edge pull lip', 'hardware', mat, x0, x0 + lip, yb, yb + t, a, b, 'y', 'z', '', extra) if lip > 0.5
            else
              panel('Edge pull', 'hardware', mat, x1, x1 + t, e0, e1, a, b, 'x', 'z', '', extra)
              panel('Edge pull lip', 'hardware', mat, x1 - lip, x1, yb, yb + t, a, b, 'y', 'z', '', extra) if lip > 0.5
            end
          end
        end

        # Black aluminium frame + glass, for the picture only (cut: false; listed in the hardware).
        # Outer 8 mm of the profile at full depth, the rest of its 45 mm face set back by the
        # glass thickness; the glass lies in that rebate, flush with the frame face.
        def glass_front(x0, x1, z0, z1, tag, extra)
          pw = Params::GLASS_PROFILE_W
          b = Params::GLASS_BORDER
          gt = Params::GLASS_T
          w = x1 - x0
          h = z1 - z0
          if w < 2 * pw + 20 || h < 2 * pw + 20
            warn("#{tag}: glass door is too small for the #{fmt pw} mm aluminium frame (#{fmt w}×#{fmt h} mm).")
          end
          y0, y1 = @inset ? [0.0, @ft] : [-@ft, 0.0]
          # 'glass_door': drawn in SketchUp as one "Glass door" component holding a frame
          # component and a glass component (see Geometry.draw_glass_doors)
          fx = extra.merge('tag' => tag, 'cut' => false, 'glass_door' => "#{fmt w}x#{fmt h}")
          fx.delete('note')
          al = Params::ALU_MAT
          name = 'Glass door frame'
          # four bars mitred at 45° in the corners (trapezoids seen from the front); each bar
          # in two strips: the outer 8 mm at full depth, the rest set back by the glass
          # each: [outer start, outer end, inner end, inner start]
          bars = {
            'bottom' => [[x0, z0], [x1, z0], [x1 - pw, z0 + pw], [x0 + pw, z0 + pw]],
            'top' => [[x0, z1], [x1, z1], [x1 - pw, z1 - pw], [x0 + pw, z1 - pw]],
            'left' => [[x0, z0], [x0, z1], [x0 + pw, z1 - pw], [x0 + pw, z0 + pw]],
            'right' => [[x1, z0], [x1, z1], [x1 - pw, z1 - pw], [x1 - pw, z0 + pw]]
          }
          inset = lambda do |quad, d0, d1| # the strip between d0 and d1 mm in from the outer edge
            o0, o1, i1, i0 = quad
            lerp = ->(a, c, k) { [a[0] + (c[0] - a[0]) * k, a[1] + (c[1] - a[1]) * k] }
            k0 = d0 / pw
            k1 = d1 / pw
            [lerp.call(o0, i0, k0), lerp.call(o1, i1, k0), lerp.call(o1, i1, k1), lerp.call(o0, i0, k1)]
          end
          bars.each_value do |q|
            grain = (q[0][1] - q[1][1]).abs < 0.01 ? 'x' : 'z'
            prism(name, 'front', al, 'y', y0, y1 - y0, inset.call(q, 0.0, b), grain, '', fx)
            prism(name, 'front', al, 'y', y0 + gt, y1 - y0 - gt, inset.call(q, b, pw), grain, '', fx)
          end
          panel('Glass', 'front', Params::GLASS_MAT, x0 + b, x1 - b, y0, y0 + gt, z0 + b, z1 - b, 'y', 'z', '', fx)
          hw("Black aluminium glass door #{fmt w} × #{fmt h} mm (#{fmt pw} × #{fmt Params::GLASS_PROFILE_T} mm profile, #{fmt gt} mm bronze glass)", 1)
        end

        # Full-length "G" profile along one edge, filling the strip taken off the panel:
        # back wall, top plate, a finger lip hanging at the front, and a base plate on the panel.
        def pull_profile(side, x0, x1, z0, z1, h, yf, yb, mat, mv)
          w = 2.0
          lip = [[f('profile_grip'), h - 2 * w - 2].min, w + 1].max
          # (d = distance in from the outer edge, y) — d 0 is the edge, d h the panel joint
          g = [[0, yf], [0, yb], [h, yb], [h, yf], [h - w, yf], [h - w, yb - w], [w, yb - w], [w, yf + w], [lip, yf + w], [lip, yf]]
          extra = mv.merge('cut' => false)
          case side
          when :top    then prism('Pull profile', 'hardware', mat, 'x', x0, x1 - x0, g.map { |d, y| [y, z1 - d] }, 'x', '', extra)
          when :bottom then prism('Pull profile', 'hardware', mat, 'x', x0, x1 - x0, g.map { |d, y| [y, z0 + d] }, 'x', '', extra)
          when :left   then prism('Pull profile', 'hardware', mat, 'z', z0, z1 - z0, g.map { |d, y| [x0 + d, y] }, 'z', '', extra)
          else              prism('Pull profile', 'hardware', mat, 'z', z0, z1 - z0, g.map { |d, y| [x1 - d, y] }, 'z', '', extra)
          end
        end

        # Glass doors are 20 mm deep (the aluminium profile): their back face stays where a
        # wooden door's is, so hinges and pulls line up the same way.
        def door(base, x0, x1, z0, z1, side, tag, c, sl, idx = nil)
          return door_body(base, x0, x1, z0, z1, side, tag, c, sl, idx) unless @glass
          ft = @ft
          @ft = Params::GLASS_PROFILE_T
          begin
            door_body(base, x0, x1, z0, z1, side, tag, c, sl, idx)
          ensure
            @ft = ft
          end
        end

        def door_body(base, x0, x1, z0, z1, side, tag, c, sl, idx = nil)
          flap = %w[T B].include?(side)
          n = hinge_count(flap ? x1 - x0 : z1 - z0)
          y0, y1 = @inset ? [0.0, @ft] : [-@ft, 0.0]
          id = "#{tag}-D#{idx}"
          name = { 'L' => 'left', 'R' => 'right', 'T' => 'top (lift-up)', 'B' => 'bottom (drop-down flap)' }[side]
          mv = case side
               when 'L' then { 'pivot' => [x0, y0, z0], 'axis' => 'z', 'angle' => -f('door_angle') }
               when 'R' then { 'pivot' => [x1, y0, z0], 'axis' => 'z', 'angle' => f('door_angle') }
               when 'T' then { 'pivot' => [x0, y0, z1], 'axis' => 'x', 'angle' => -f('lift_angle') }
               else          { 'pivot' => [x0, y0, z0], 'axis' => 'x', 'angle' => f('flap_angle') }
               end
          add_mover(mv.merge('id' => id, 'kind' => 'door', 'hinge' => side, 'tag' => tag, 'at' => [r((x0 + x1) / 2.0), r((z0 + z1) / 2.0)],
                             'pivot' => mv['pivot'].map { |q| r(q) }, 'label' => "Door #{tag}#{idx ? " #{idx}" : ''}"))
          note = "#{n} hinges, hinged #{name}"
          front_with_pull(:door, base, :door, x0, x1, z0, z1, tag, { 'note' => note, 'mover' => id }, flap ? nil : side)
          hw(hinge_name, n)
          hw('Hinge mounting plate', n) unless flap
          hinge_hardware(side, n, x0, x1, z0, z1, y1, c, sl, id)
          case side
          when 'T'
            hw('Lift-up fitting set, soft-close (e.g. Blum AVENTOS HK top / HK-S) — size to front weight', 1)
            warn("#{tag}: lift-up door is #{fmt(z1 - z0)} mm tall — check the lift fitting's height range.") if z1 - z0 > 600
          when 'B'
            hw('Flap stay / lid support, soft-close (pair)', 1)
            warn("#{tag}: drop-down flap is #{fmt(z1 - z0)} mm tall — keep flaps under ~600 mm.") if z1 - z0 > 600
          else
            warn("#{tag}: single door is #{fmt(x1 - x0)} mm wide — consider a door pair.") if x1 - x0 > 650
          end
        end

        # Positions along a hinge edge: ~100 mm from each end, the rest spread evenly.
        def hinge_positions(a, b, n)
          len = b - a
          e = len >= 260 ? 100.0 : len * 0.22
          return [(a + b) / 2.0] if n < 2
          (0...n).map { |k| a + e + (len - 2 * e) * k / (n - 1) }
        end

        # Visible hinge hardware: 35 mm cups in the door (move with it) and, for
        # side-hung doors in frameless boxes, mounting plates on the cabinet side.
        def hinge_hardware(side, n, x0, x1, z0, z1, yback, c, sl, id)
          cup_d = 12.0
          off = 22.5
          cy = yback - cup_d
          if %w[L R].include?(side)
            cx = side == 'L' ? x0 + off : x1 - off
            zs = hinge_positions(z0, z1, n)
            if @ff
              zs.each { |zc| cyl('Hinge cup', Params::METAL, [cx, cy, zc], 'y', 17.5, cup_d, 'mover' => id) }
              return
            end
            # 'hinge': where the real hinge model goes (models/hinge_*.skp, origin = cup centre on
            # the door's back face) — see su/hw_models.rb. The cup and plate are the fallback.
            hx0 = c['hx0'] || c['x0']
            hx1 = c['hx1'] || c['x1']
            # side_x: inside face of the panel the hinge screws to (the model's plate goes there)
            zs.each do |zc|
              cyl('Hinge cup', Params::METAL, [cx, cy, zc], 'y', 17.5, cup_d, 'mover' => id,
                  'hinge' => { 'side' => side, 'x' => r(cx), 'y' => r(yback), 'z' => r(zc), 'door' => id,
                               'side_x' => r(side == 'L' ? hx0 : hx1) })
            end
            px0, px1 = side == 'L' ? [hx0, hx0 + 10] : [hx1 - 10, hx1]
            py0 = @y_int_front + 25
            zs.each do |zc|
              zc = [[zc, sl['iz0'] + 25].max, sl['iz1'] - 25].min
              hardware_box('Hinge plate', px0, px1, py0, py0 + 24, zc - 20, zc + 20, 'x', 'hinge_of' => id)
            end
          else
            cz = side == 'T' ? z1 - off : z0 + off
            hinge_positions(x0, x1, n).each { |xc| cyl('Hinge cup', Params::METAL, [xc, cy, cz], 'y', 17.5, cup_d, 'mover' => id) }
            return if @ff
            fy0 = @y_int_front + 10
            if side == 'T'
              fz1 = sl['iz1'] - 10
              fz0 = [fz1 - 100, sl['iz0'] + 5].max
              fd = [220.0, @y_back_front - fy0 - 10].min
              hardware_box('Lift fitting', c['x0'], c['x0'] + 20, fy0, fy0 + fd, fz0, fz1, 'x')
              hardware_box('Lift fitting', c['x1'] - 20, c['x1'], fy0, fy0 + fd, fz0, fz1, 'x')
            else
              fz0 = sl['iz0'] + 15
              fd = [160.0, @y_back_front - fy0 - 10].min
              hardware_box('Flap stay', c['x0'], c['x0'] + 12, fy0, fy0 + fd, fz0, fz0 + 30, 'x')
              hardware_box('Flap stay', c['x1'] - 12, c['x1'], fy0, fy0 + fd, fz0, fz0 + 30, 'x')
            end
          end
        end

        # ------------------------------------------------------------------ contents
        # Doors stacked in one column: their pulls meet at the joint, like a door pair meets
        # in the middle. Paired from the bottom up (2 → one pair, 3 → bottom pair + the top
        # door's pull at its bottom corner, 4 → two pairs). Returns slot index → :top / :bottom.
        def stacked_pulls(c)
          out = {}
          side_hung = ->(rw) { %w[door_pair glass_door_pair].include?(rw['front']) || (%w[door glass_door].include?(rw['front']) && %w[L R].include?(rw['hinge'])) }
          run = []
          flush = lambda do
            if run.size >= 2
              k = run.size - 1
              while k >= 1
                out[run[k]] = :top          # lower door of the pair: pull at its top
                out[run[k - 1]] = :bottom   # upper door: pull at its bottom
                k -= 2
              end
              out[run[0]] = :bottom if k.zero? # odd count: the top door alone, bottom corner
            end
            run = []
          end
          c['slots'].each_with_index { |sl, j| side_hung.call(sl['row']) ? run << j : flush.call }
          flush.call
          out
        end

        def contents
          @cols.each do |c|
            next if c['knee']
            meet = stacked_pulls(c)
            c['slots'].each_with_index do |sl, j|
              @pull_v = meet[j]
              rw = sl['row']
              tag = sl['tag']
              if @divider && !sl['last']
                panel('Fixed shelf', 'carcass', @mc, c['x0'], c['x1'], @cy0, @y_back_front,
                      sl['z0'] - @t / 2.0, sl['z0'] + @t / 2.0, 'z', 'x', '1L')
              end
              x0, x1, z0, z1 = front_rect(c, sl)
              # glass doors: Fronts › Front style "Glass" (all doors; drawer fronts stay wood),
              # or rows set to glass in versions 0.3.21–0.3.23
              @glass = rw['front'].to_s.start_with?('glass_') || (s('front_style') == 'glass' && %w[door door_pair].include?(rw['front']))
              case rw['front']
              when 'door', 'glass_door'
                door('Door', x0, x1, z0, z1, rw['hinge'], tag, c, sl)
              when 'door_pair', 'glass_door_pair'
                m = (x0 + x1) / 2.0
                door('Door', x0, m - @gap / 2.0, z0, z1, 'L', tag, c, sl, 1)
                door('Door', m + @gap / 2.0, x1, z0, z1, 'R', tag, c, sl, 2)
              when 'drawer'
                # drawers are numbered 1, 2, 3… top to bottom, left column first
                n = (@drawer_n += 1)
                did = "#{tag}-DR"
                front_with_pull(:drawer, 'Drawer front', :drawer, x0, x1, z0, z1, tag, { 'mover' => did, 'num' => n }, nil)
                travel = drawer_box(c, sl, tag, did, n)
                add_mover('id' => did, 'kind' => 'drawer', 'tag' => tag, 'label' => "Drawer #{n}", 'num' => n, 'at' => [r((x0 + x1) / 2.0), r((z0 + z1) / 2.0)],
                          'travel' => r((travel || 300.0) * f('drawer_ext') / 100.0))
              when 'false_front'
                make_front('False front', :drawer, x0, x1, z0, z1, tag, 'note' => 'fixed — no box')
              end
              @pull_v = nil
              @glass = false
              next if rw['front'] == 'drawer'
              case rw['interior']
              when 'shelves' then shelves(c, sl, rw['shelves'].to_i, tag)
              when 'hang' then hang(c, sl)
              end
            end
          end
          if @stile_proud && @cols.any? { |c| !c['knee'] && c['rows'].any? { |rw| rw['front'] == 'drawer' } }
            warn('Face-frame stiles stand proud of the sides — pack out drawer slides with spacer blocks.')
          end
        end

        # ------------------------------------------------------------------ NOOKS
        # The interior split into spaces (see Params.nook_norm). Sizes are clear sizes between
        # panel faces; every split is a panel: a partition side by side, a fixed shelf one above
        # the other. Each nook is then built like a row of a column (same fronts, doors,
        # drawers, shelves, rails), through a column-like and a row-like hash.
        def nooks_layout
          zlo = @ff ? @base_z : @bottom_under
          @nook_leaves = []
          @nook_cuts = []
          box = { 'x0' => @cx0 + @t, 'x1' => @cx1 - @t, 'z0' => @bottom_top, 'z1' => @top_under,
                  'L' => true, 'R' => true, 'T' => true, 'B' => true }
          nook_place(@p['nooks'], box, '0')
          @nook_leaves.each_with_index do |lf, i|
            b = lf['box']
            tag = "N#{i + 1}"
            lf['tag'] = tag
            lf['c'] = { 'x0' => b['x0'], 'x1' => b['x1'], 'first' => b['L'], 'last' => b['R'], 'cl' => b['x0'] - @t / 2.0,
                        'cr' => b['x1'] + @t / 2.0, 'tag' => tag, 'rows' => [lf['node']], 'knee' => false }
            lf['sl'] = { 'row' => lf['node'], 'tag' => tag, 'first' => b['T'], 'last' => b['B'],
                         'z0' => b['B'] ? zlo : b['z0'] - @t / 2.0, 'z1' => b['T'] ? @top : b['z1'] + @t / 2.0,
                         'iz0' => b['z0'], 'iz1' => b['z1'], 'div_lo' => true, 'div_hi' => true }
          end
        end

        def nook_place(node, box, path)
          w = box['x1'] - box['x0']
          h = box['z1'] - box['z0']
          if w < 40 || h < 40
            warn("A nook came out too small (#{fmt w}×#{fmt h} mm) — check the NOOKS sizes.")
          end
          unless node['parts']
            @nook_leaves << { 'node' => node, 'box' => box, 'path' => path }
            return
          end
          parts = node['parts']
          n = parts.size
          side = node['split'] == 'v'
          avail = (side ? w : h) - (n - 1) * @t
          raise BuildError, "NOOKS: no room for #{n} spaces (#{fmt avail} mm)." if avail < 20 * n
          sizes = distribute(parts.map { |q| q['size'] }, avail, side ? 'nook widths' : 'nook heights')
          if side
            x = box['x0']
            parts.each_with_index do |q, i|
              sub = box.merge('x0' => x, 'x1' => x + sizes[i], 'L' => box['L'] && i.zero?, 'R' => box['R'] && i == n - 1)
              nook_place(q, sub, "#{path}.#{i}")
              @nook_cuts << { 'kind' => 'v', 'x0' => x + sizes[i], 'x1' => x + sizes[i] + @t, 'z0' => box['z0'], 'z1' => box['z1'] } if i < n - 1
              x += sizes[i] + @t
            end
          else
            z = box['z1'] # first part on top
            parts.each_with_index do |q, i|
              sub = box.merge('z1' => z, 'z0' => z - sizes[i], 'T' => box['T'] && i.zero?, 'B' => box['B'] && i == n - 1)
              nook_place(q, sub, "#{path}.#{i}")
              @nook_cuts << { 'kind' => 'h', 'x0' => box['x0'], 'x1' => box['x1'], 'z0' => z - sizes[i] - @t, 'z1' => z - sizes[i] } if i < n - 1
              (@nook_root_cuts ||= []) << r(z - sizes[i] - @t / 2.0) if path == '0' && i < n - 1
              z -= sizes[i] + @t
            end
          end
        end

        def nooks_contents
          @nook_cuts.each do |k|
            if k['kind'] == 'v'
              panel('Partition', 'carcass', @mc, k['x0'], k['x1'], @cy0, @y_back_front, k['z0'], k['z1'], 'x', 'z', '1L', 'note' => 'nook')
            else
              panel('Fixed shelf', 'carcass', @mc, k['x0'], k['x1'], @cy0, @y_back_front, k['z0'], k['z1'], 'z', 'x', '1L', 'note' => 'nook')
            end
          end
          @nook_leaves.each do |lf|
            nd = lf['node']
            c = lf['c']
            sl = lf['sl']
            tag = lf['tag']
            @glass = s('front_style') == 'glass' && %w[door door_pair].include?(nd['front'])
            x0, x1, z0, z1 = front_rect(c, sl)
            case nd['front']
            when 'door'
              door('Door', x0, x1, z0, z1, nd['hinge'], tag, c, sl)
            when 'door_pair'
              m = (x0 + x1) / 2.0
              door('Door', x0, m - @gap / 2.0, z0, z1, 'L', tag, c, sl, 1)
              door('Door', m + @gap / 2.0, x1, z0, z1, 'R', tag, c, sl, 2)
            when 'drawer'
              nook_drawers(nd, c, sl, tag)
            when 'false_front'
              make_front('False front', :drawer, x0, x1, z0, z1, tag, 'note' => 'fixed — no box')
            end
            @glass = false
            next if nd['front'] == 'drawer'
            case nd['interior']
            when 'shelves' then shelves(c, sl, nd['shelves'].to_i, tag)
            when 'hang' then hang(c, sl)
            end
          end
        end

        # A nook with drawers: n drawers stacked in it (no shelves between them).
        def nook_drawers(nd, c, sl, tag)
          n = nd['drawers'].to_i.clamp(1, 8)
          hz = (sl['z1'] - sl['z0']) / n
          (0...n).each do |k|
            top = sl['z1'] - hz * k
            sub = sl.merge('z1' => top, 'z0' => top - hz, 'first' => sl['first'] && k.zero?, 'last' => sl['last'] && k == n - 1,
                           'div_hi' => k.zero?, 'div_lo' => k == n - 1,
                           'iz1' => k.zero? ? sl['iz1'] : top, 'iz0' => k == n - 1 ? sl['iz0'] : top - hz)
            stag = n > 1 ? "#{tag}.#{k + 1}" : tag
            x0, x1, z0, z1 = front_rect(c, sub)
            num = (@drawer_n += 1)
            did = "#{stag}-DR"
            front_with_pull(:drawer, 'Drawer front', :drawer, x0, x1, z0, z1, stag, { 'mover' => did, 'num' => num }, nil)
            travel = drawer_box(c, sub, stag, did, num)
            add_mover('id' => did, 'kind' => 'drawer', 'tag' => stag, 'label' => "Drawer #{num}", 'num' => num,
                      'at' => [r((x0 + x1) / 2.0), r((z0 + z1) / 2.0)], 'travel' => r((travel || 300.0) * f('drawer_ext') / 100.0))
          end
        end

        # For the NOOKS editor: every nook (path, clear box, what it holds) and every split panel.
        def nooks_summary
          {
            'box' => [r(@cx0 + @t), r(@bottom_top), r(@cx1 - @t), r(@top_under)],
            'leaves' => @nook_leaves.map do |lf|
              b = lf['box']
              { 'path' => lf['path'], 'tag' => lf['tag'], 'x0' => r(b['x0']), 'x1' => r(b['x1']), 'z0' => r(b['z0']), 'z1' => r(b['z1']),
                'w' => r(b['x1'] - b['x0']), 'h' => r(b['z1'] - b['z0']), 'front' => lf['node']['front'],
                'interior' => lf['node']['interior'], 'drawers' => lf['node']['drawers'], 'hinge' => lf['node']['hinge'] }
            end,
            'cuts' => @nook_cuts.map { |k| k.transform_values { |v| v.is_a?(Numeric) ? r(v) : v } },
            'root_cuts' => @nook_root_cuts || []
          }
        end

        def shelves(c, sl, n, tag)
          return if n <= 0
          z0 = sl['iz0']
          z1 = sl['iz1']
          pitch = (z1 - z0) / (n + 1)
          if pitch < @t + 40
            warn("#{tag}: #{n} shelves don't fit (#{fmt(z1 - z0)} mm space).")
            return
          end
          sc = f('shelf_clear')
          (1..n).each do |k|
            zc = z0 + pitch * k
            sx0 = c['x0'] + sc
            sx1 = c['x1'] - sc
            sy0 = @y_int_front + f('shelf_setback')
            sy1 = @y_back_front - 2
            if @cn && c.equal?(@cn['col']) && @cn['div_y1'] > sy0
              # notched around the hinge divider
              d0 = @cn['div_x0'] - sc
              d1 = @cn['div_x1'] + sc
              ny = @cn['div_y1'] + sc
              pts = [[sx0, sy0], [d0, sy0], [d0, ny], [d1, ny], [d1, sy0], [sx1, sy0], [sx1, sy1], [sx0, sy1]]
              pts = [[sx0, ny], [d1, ny], [d1, sy0], [sx1, sy0], [sx1, sy1], [sx0, sy1]] if d0 <= sx0 + 1
              pts = [[sx0, sy0], [d0, sy0], [d0, ny], [sx1, ny], [sx1, sy1], [sx0, sy1]] if d1 >= sx1 - 1
              prism('Adj. shelf', 'shelf', @mc, 'z', zc - @t / 2.0, @t, pts, 'x', '1L',
                    'note' => "notched #{fmt(d1 - d0)}×#{fmt(ny - sy0)} around the hinge divider")
            else
              panel('Adj. shelf', 'shelf', @mc, sx0, sx1, sy0, sy1, zc - @t / 2.0, zc + @t / 2.0, 'z', 'x', '1L')
            end
          end
          hw('Shelf pin', 4 * n)
        end

        def hang(c, sl)
          zr = sl['iz1'] - f('rod_drop')
          yc = (@y_int_front + @y_back_front) / 2.0
          len = c['x1'] - c['x0'] - 2
          cyl('Hanging rail', Params::METAL, [c['x0'] + 1, yc, zr], 'x', 12.5, len)
          hw("Wardrobe rail (cut to #{fmt len} mm)", 1)
          hw('Wardrobe rail support (pair)', 1)
          hangers(c['x0'], c['x1'], yc, zr, sl['iz0'])
        end

        # Clothes hangers on a rail, for the look only (Hardware tag; not in the cut list or the
        # hardware list). Unevenly spaced and each one turned a little about its hook. The spread
        # comes from a fixed seed (the rail's place and size), so a rebuild draws the same ones.
        HANGER_GAPS = { 'half' => [120, 200], 'normal' => [70, 110], 'full' => [52, 75] }.freeze
        def hangers(x0, x1, yc, zr, zfloor)
          gaps = HANGER_GAPS[@p['hangers'] || 'normal']
          return unless gaps
          depth = @y_back_front - @y_int_front
          w = [440.0, depth - 50].min
          neck = zr - 34
          drop = [w * 0.2, 90].min
          return if w < 200 || neck - drop - 10 < zfloor
          rng = Random.new([x0, x1, yc, zr, depth].map { |v| v.round }.inject(17) { |a, v| (a * 31 + v) % 2_147_483_647 })
          xs = []
          x = x0 + 30 + rng.rand * 20
          while x < x1 - 30
            xs << x
            x += gaps[0] + rng.rand * (gaps[1] - gaps[0])
          end
          xs.each do |xi|
            room = [xi - x0, x1 - xi].min - 8
            lim = [12.0, Math.asin([[room / (w / 2.0), 1.0].min, 0.0].max) * 180 / Math::PI].min
            hanger(xi, yc, zr, neck, w, drop, (rng.rand * 2 - 1) * lim)
          end
        end

        # One hanger in the plane across the rail (y–z), 6 mm thick, turned rz degrees about the
        # vertical through its hook: hook over the rail, stem, two shoulders and the bottom bar.
        def hanger(xi, yc, zr, neck, w, drop, rz)
          ex = { 'cut' => false, 'deco' => 'hanger', 'rz' => r(rz), 'rc' => [r(xi), r(yc)] }
          t = 6
          px = xi - t / 2.0
          arc = []
          n = 9
          (0..n).each { |k| a = Math::PI * (-0.15 + 1.25 * k / n); arc << [yc + 17 * Math.cos(a), zr + 17 * Math.sin(a)] }
          (0..n).to_a.reverse.each { |k| a = Math::PI * (-0.15 + 1.25 * k / n); arc << [yc + 13 * Math.cos(a), zr + 13 * Math.sin(a)] }
          prism('Clothes hanger', 'hardware', Params::METAL, 'x', px, t, arc, 'y', '', ex)
          sy = yc + 15 * Math.cos(-0.15 * Math::PI)
          sz = zr + 15 * Math.sin(-0.15 * Math::PI)
          prism('Clothes hanger', 'hardware', Params::METAL, 'x', px, t, [[yc - 2, neck], [yc + 2, neck], [sy + 2, sz], [sy - 2, sz]], 'y', '', ex)
          tz = neck - drop
          [-1, 1].each do |sd|
            ty = yc + sd * w / 2.0
            pts = [[yc, neck + 7], [ty, tz + 4], [ty, tz - 6], [yc, neck - 9]]
            pts = pts.reverse if sd < 0
            prism('Clothes hanger', 'hardware', Params::METAL, 'x', px, t, pts, 'y', '', ex)
          end
          prism('Clothes hanger', 'hardware', Params::METAL, 'x', px, t,
                [[yc - w / 2.0 + 8, tz - 6], [yc + w / 2.0 - 8, tz - 6], [yc + w / 2.0 - 8, tz - 1], [yc - w / 2.0 + 8, tz - 1]], 'y', '', ex)
        end

        def slide_length(avail)
          list = s('slide_lengths').split(/[,; ]+/).map { |x| x.to_f }.select { |x| x > 0 }
          list.select { |l| l <= avail }.max
        end

        # Returns the runner length (NL) — full-extension travel.
        def drawer_box(c, sl, tag, did = nil, num = nil)
          sys = s('drawer_system')
          ox0 = c['hx0'] || c['x0']
          ox1 = c['hx1'] || c['x1']
          z0 = sl['iz0']
          z1 = sl['iz1']
          if @ff
            fo0, fo1 = ff_open_x(c)
            oz0, oz1 = ff_open_z(sl)
            ox0 = [ox0, fo0].max
            ox1 = [ox1, fo1].min
            z0 = [z0, oz0].max
            z1 = [z1, oz1].min
          end
          ow = ox1 - ox0
          avail = @y_back_front - @y_int_front - 10
          nl = slide_length(avail)
          unless nl
            warn("#{tag}: no slide length in your list fits #{fmt avail} mm of depth.")
            return
          end
          yf = @y_int_front
          cb = f('db_clear_bottom')
          ct = f('db_clear_top')
          bz0 = z0 + cb
          bh = z1 - z0 - cb - ct
          if bh < 50
            warn("#{tag}: drawer opening leaves only #{fmt bh} mm for a box.")
            return
          end

          if sys == 'box_system'
            sh = f('bx_side_h')
            if sh > bh
              warn("#{tag}: box-system side height #{fmt sh} mm is taller than the #{fmt bh} mm available.")
              sh = bh
            end
            bxt = f('bx_bottom_t')
            mv = { 'mover' => did, 'num' => num }
            hardware_box('Box side (metal)', ox0 + 3, ox0 + 16, yf, yf + nl - 2, bz0, bz0 + sh, 'x', mv)
            hardware_box('Box side (metal)', ox1 - 16, ox1 - 3, yf, yf + nl - 2, bz0, bz0 + sh, 'x', mv)
            rz = bz0 + [sh * 0.3, 20.0].max
            hardware_box('Runner (cabinet)', ox0, ox0 + 3, yf + 5, yf + nl - 10, rz, rz + 25, 'x')
            hardware_box('Runner (cabinet)', ox1 - 3, ox1, yf + 5, yf + nl - 10, rz, rz + 25, 'x')
            bs = Params.box_system(@p)
            custom = @p['bx_custom']
            gallery = @p['bx_gallery']
            bw = ow - f('bx_bottom_w_deduct')
            bd = nl - f('bx_bottom_d_deduct')
            cxm = (ox0 + ox1) / 2.0
            slot = bs['slot']
            reb = bxt > slot + 0.05
            check = custom || bs['check'] ? '; check against the manufacturer' : ''
            bnote = "LW #{fmt ow} − #{fmt f('bx_bottom_w_deduct')} × NL #{fmt nl} − #{fmt f('bx_bottom_d_deduct')}"
            bnote += "; rebate left and right edges underneath to #{fmt slot} mm" if reb
            panel('Box bottom', 'drawer', @md, cxm - bw / 2.0, cxm + bw / 2.0, yf, yf + bd, bz0, bz0 + bxt, 'z', 'x', '',
                  'tag' => tag, 'mover' => did, 'num' => num, 'note' => bnote + check)
            kw = ow - f('bx_back_w_deduct')
            kh = f('bx_back_h')
            if bxt + kh > bh
              warn("#{tag}: the #{fmt kh} mm box back is taller than the #{fmt bh - bxt} mm available.")
              kh = bh - bxt
            end
            knote = "LW #{fmt ow} − #{fmt f('bx_back_w_deduct')}"
            knote += "; rebate both ends on the back face to #{fmt slot} mm" if reb
            panel('Box back', 'drawer', @md, cxm - kw / 2.0, cxm + kw / 2.0, yf + bd - bxt, yf + bd, bz0 + bxt, bz0 + bxt + kh,
                  'y', 'x', '', 'tag' => tag, 'mover' => did, 'num' => num, 'note' => knote + check)
            name = custom ? 'Box-system drawer set' : "#{bs['label']} drawer set, height #{s('bx_height')}"
            hw("#{name} (side #{fmt sh} mm), NL #{fmt nl}", 1)
            if gallery
              # one rail per side, along the top of the box at the back's height
              gz = bz0 + bxt + kh - 6
              [ox0 + 9.5, ox1 - 9.5].each do |gx|
                cyl('Gallery rail', Params::METAL, [gx, yf + 10, gz], 'y', 6, nl - 30, mv)
              end
              hw("Gallery rail set (pair), NL #{fmt nl}", 1)
            end
            return nl
          end

          d = f('db_t')
          bott = f('db_bottom_t')
          bw = sys == 'side_mount' ? ow - 25.4 : ow - 10
          bx0 = (ox0 + ox1) / 2.0 - bw / 2.0
          bx1 = bx0 + bw
          ext = { 'tag' => tag, 'mover' => did, 'num' => num }
          panel('Drawer side', 'drawer', @md, bx0, bx0 + d, yf, yf + nl, bz0, bz0 + bh, 'x', 'y', '1L 1W', ext)
          panel('Drawer side', 'drawer', @md, bx1 - d, bx1, yf, yf + nl, bz0, bz0 + bh, 'x', 'y', '1L 1W', ext)
          # Wooden box: front and back cross pieces are the same piece (same height as the sides),
          # the bottom sits inside all four — one cut-list line, Qty 2.
          panel('Drawer cross piece', 'drawer', @md, bx0 + d, bx1 - d, yf, yf + d, bz0, bz0 + bh, 'y', 'x', '1L', ext)
          panel('Drawer cross piece', 'drawer', @md, bx0 + d, bx1 - d, yf + nl - d, yf + nl, bz0, bz0 + bh, 'y', 'x', '1L', ext)
          if sys == 'undermount'
            bzb = bz0 + 13
            if s('db_bottom_fit') == 'slotted'
              panel('Drawer bottom', 'drawer', @md, bx0 + d - 6, bx1 - d + 6, yf + d - 6, yf + nl - d + 6, bzb, bzb + bott, 'z', 'x', '',
                    ext.merge('note' => '6 mm into grooves all round, recessed 13 mm'))
            else
              panel('Drawer bottom', 'drawer', @md, bx0 + d, bx1 - d, yf + d, yf + nl - d, bzb, bzb + bott, 'z', 'x', '',
                    ext.merge('note' => 'nested between all four box sides, 13 mm up for the runners'))
            end
            hw("Undermount soft-close runner pair, full extension, NL #{fmt nl}", 1)
            hw('Runner locking device (pair)', 1)
            # cabinet member below the box, drawer member under the bottom (moves)
            rh = [cb - 2, 12.0].min
            if rh >= 2
              hardware_box('Runner (cabinet)', ox0, ox0 + 25, yf + 5, yf + nl - 10, bz0 - rh - 1, bz0 - 1, 'z')
              hardware_box('Runner (cabinet)', ox1 - 25, ox1, yf + 5, yf + nl - 10, bz0 - rh - 1, bz0 - 1, 'z')
            end
            hardware_box('Runner (drawer)', bx0 + d, bx0 + d + 14, yf + 20, yf + nl - 10, bz0 + 1, bz0 + 12, 'z', ext)
            hardware_box('Runner (drawer)', bx1 - d - 14, bx1 - d, yf + 20, yf + nl - 10, bz0 + 1, bz0 + 12, 'z', ext)
          else
            if s('db_bottom_fit') == 'slotted'
              panel('Drawer bottom', 'drawer', @md, bx0 + d - 6, bx1 - d + 6, yf + d - 6, yf + nl - d + 6, bz0 + 10, bz0 + 10 + bott,
                    'z', 'x', '', ext.merge('note' => '6 mm into grooves all round'))
            else
              panel('Drawer bottom', 'drawer', @md, bx0 + d, bx1 - d, yf + d, yf + nl - d, bz0, bz0 + bott,
                    'z', 'x', '', ext.merge('note' => 'nested between all four box sides, flush underneath'))
            end
            hw("Full-extension ball-bearing slide pair, soft-close, #{fmt nl} mm", 1)
            gap = (bw - (ox1 - ox0)).abs / 2.0
            zm = bz0 + bh / 2.0
            if gap >= 4
              # Simple boxes for the preview; in SketchUp they are replaced by the slide model
              # (models/slide_closed.skp / slide_open.skp) when it is installed — see su/hw_models.rb.
              sm = ->(side, face) { { 'slide' => { 'side' => side, 'face_x' => r(face), 'y' => r(yf), 'zc' => r(zm), 'len' => nl, 'drawer' => did } } }
              hardware_box('Slide (cabinet)', ox0, ox0 + gap / 2.0, yf, yf + nl - 2, zm - 22, zm + 22, 'x', sm.('L', ox0))
              hardware_box('Slide (cabinet)', ox1 - gap / 2.0, ox1, yf, yf + nl - 2, zm - 22, zm + 22, 'x', sm.('R', ox1))
              hardware_box('Slide (drawer)', ox0 + gap / 2.0, bx0, yf, yf + nl - 2, zm - 18, zm + 18, 'x', ext.merge('slide_of' => did))
              hardware_box('Slide (drawer)', bx1, ox1 - gap / 2.0, yf, yf + nl - 2, zm - 18, zm + 18, 'x', ext.merge('slide_of' => did))
            end
          end
          nl
        end

        # ------------------------------------------------------------------ bbox
        def bbox
          mn = [1e9, 1e9, 1e9]
          mx = [-1e9, -1e9, -1e9]
          idx = { 'x' => 0, 'y' => 1, 'z' => 2 }
          @parts.each do |pt|
            if pt['shape'] == 'cyl'
              a = idx[pt['axis']]
              3.times do |i|
                lo = pt['center'][i] - (i == a ? 0 : pt['r'])
                hi = pt['center'][i] + (i == a ? pt['len'] : pt['r'])
                mn[i] = [mn[i], lo].min
                mx[i] = [mx[i], hi].max
              end
            else
              a = pt['axis']
              u, v = plane_axes(a)
              [[a, [pt['pos'], pt['pos'] + pt['thk']]],
               [u, pt['pts'].map { |q| q[0] }],
               [v, pt['pts'].map { |q| q[1] }]].each do |ax, vals|
                i = idx[ax]
                mn[i] = [mn[i], vals.min].min
                mx[i] = [mx[i], vals.max].max
              end
            end
          end
          [mn, mx]
        end
      end
    end
  end

# encoding: UTF-8
# CSPARTNERS PANEL PRO — cut list, edge banding, sheet estimate and hardware totals.
# Pure Ruby. Input: modules as { 'code', 'name', 'res' }; part names via Names.

module CSPartners
  module PanelPro
    module Cutlist
      SHEET_L = 2440.0
      SHEET_W = 1220.0
      WASTE = 1.15

      def self.whole_mm(v)
        (v.to_f + 1e-6).round.to_f
      end

      def self.fmt(v)
        v = (v.to_f * 10).round / 10.0
        v == v.to_i ? v.to_i.to_s : v.to_s
      end

      # modules: list of { 'code', 'name', 'res' } (or legacy [name, res] pairs).
      # boards:  material name => { 'L', 'W', 'T' => [stocked thicknesses] } from the
      #          board library; other materials use the default 2440 × 1220 sheet.
      # opts:    'lang' ('en'/'es'), 'names' (custom part names from Settings).
      # Within one module, panels with the same name and size are one row with a Qty.
      def self.compile(modules, boards = {}, opts = {})
        lng = opts['lang'] || 'en'
        custom = opts['names'] || {}
        order = Names::PARTS.each_with_index.map { |(en, _), i| [en, i] }.to_h
        rows = {}
        hardware = {}
        band = Hash.new(0.0)
        area = Hash.new(0.0)
        warnings = []

        modules.each_with_index do |m, mi|
          m = { 'code' => '', 'name' => m[0], 'res' => m[1] } if m.is_a?(Array)
          res = m['res']
          mod_name = m['name']
          res['warnings'].each { |w| warnings << "#{mod_name}: #{w}" }
          res['hardware'].each { |item, q| hardware[item] = (hardware[item] || 0) + q }
          res['parts'].each do |pt|
            next unless pt['cut']
            # cut sizes in whole millimetres (half a millimetre can't be cut); the model keeps its exact sizes
            pt = pt.merge('L' => whole_mm(pt['L']), 'W' => whole_mm(pt['W']))
            label = Names.cut_label(pt, lng, custom)
            fl = pt['edges'] || Builder.eb_flags(pt['eb'])
            key = [mi, label, pt['L'], pt['W'], pt['T'], pt['mat'], Builder.flags_code(fl)]
            r = rows[key] ||= { 'code' => m['code'].to_s, 'module' => mod_name, 'part' => label, 'qty' => 0,
                                'mid' => m['id'], 'pids' => [], 'edges' => fl, 'eb_set' => false,
                                'L' => pt['L'], 'W' => pt['W'], 'T' => pt['T'], 'mat' => pt['mat'], 'eb' => pt['eb'].to_s,
                                'notes' => [], 'mi' => mi, 'ord' => order[Names.split(pt['name'])[0]] || 99,
                                'num' => pt['num'] || 0 }
            r['qty'] += 1
            r['pids'] << pt['pid'] if pt['pid']
            r['eb_set'] = true if pt['eb_set']
            r['notes'] << pt['note'].to_s if pt['note'] && !r['notes'].include?(pt['note'].to_s)
            area[[pt['mat'], pt['T']]] += pt['L'] * pt['W']
            l_n = (fl['L1'] ? 1 : 0) + (fl['L2'] ? 1 : 0)
            w_n = (fl['W1'] ? 1 : 0) + (fl['W2'] ? 1 : 0)
            band[pt['mat']] += l_n * pt['L'] + w_n * pt['W'] if l_n + w_n > 0
          end
        end

        list = rows.values.map do |r|
          r.merge('note' => I18n.text(r.delete('notes').join('; '), lng))
        end
        list.sort_by! { |r| [r['mi'], r['num'], r['ord'], r['part'], -r['L']] }
        list.each { |r| %w[mi ord num].each { |k| r.delete(k) } }

        sheets = area.map do |(mat, t), a|
          b = boards[mat]
          sl = b && b['L'].to_f > 0 ? b['L'].to_f : (opts['sheet_l'] || SHEET_L).to_f
          sw = b && b['W'].to_f > 0 ? b['W'].to_f : (opts['sheet_w'] || SHEET_W).to_f
          if b && !b['T'].empty? && b['T'].none? { |x| (x.to_f - t).abs < 0.05 }
            warnings << "#{mat} is stocked in #{b['T'].map { |x| fmt(x) }.join(' / ')} mm — the cut list has #{fmt t} mm parts in it."
          end
          { 'mat' => mat, 'T' => t, 'm2' => (a / 1e6).round(2), 'size' => "#{fmt sl}x#{fmt sw}",
            'sheets' => (a * WASTE / (sl * sw)).ceil }
        end.sort_by { |s| [s['mat'], s['T']] }

        {
          'rows' => list,
          'hardware' => hardware.sort.map { |i, q| { 'item' => I18n.text(i, lng), 'qty' => q } },
          'banding' => band.sort.map { |m, mm| { 'mat' => m, 'm' => (mm / 1000.0).round(1) } },
          'sheets' => sheets,
          'warnings' => warnings.map { |w| I18n.warn(w, lng) },
          'lang' => lng
        }
      end

      # Edge banding switched in the cut list. pids: the panels of one row (or of a whole
      # module); side: 'L1' 'L2' 'W1' 'W2' or 'all'; on: true / false. Returns new params:
      # 'edges' keeps only the panels that differ from what the builder gives them.
      def self.set_edges(params, pids, side, on)
        p = Params.normalize(params)
        over = p['edges'].is_a?(Hash) ? p['edges'].dup : {}
        base = Builder.build(p.merge('edges' => {}))
        std = {}
        base['parts'].each { |pt| std[pt['pid'].to_s] = pt['edges'] if pt['cut'] && pt['pid'] }
        sides = side.to_s == 'all' ? Builder::SIDES : [side.to_s] & Builder::SIDES
        Array(pids).each do |pid|
          pid = pid.to_s
          next unless std[pid]
          cur = over[pid].is_a?(String) && over[pid] =~ /\A[01]{4}\z/ ? Builder.code_flags(over[pid]) : std[pid].dup
          sides.each { |k| cur[k] = on ? true : false }
          code = Builder.flags_code(cur)
          if code == Builder.flags_code(std[pid])
            over.delete(pid)
          else
            over[pid] = code
          end
        end
        q = Params.normalize(params)
        if over.empty?
          q.delete('edges')
        else
          q['edges'] = over
        end
        q
      end

      # The cut list in blocks by material (by_t: material and thickness). Every line of the cut list
      # stays its own line, as in the module tab: identical pieces are not combined (owner, 2 Nov 2026). [{ 'title', 'mat', 'T', 'rows' => [{ codes, modules, part, qty, L, W, T, edges, mat, note }],
      #  'pieces', 'm2' }]
      def self.grouped(data, by_t = false)
        lng = data['lang'] || 'en'
        rows = {}
        data['rows'].each_with_index do |r, i|
          e = r['edges'] || {}
          key = i
          c = rows[key] ||= { 'codes' => [], 'modules' => [], 'part' => r['part'], 'qty' => 0, 'L' => r['L'], 'W' => r['W'],
                              'T' => r['T'], 'edges' => e, 'mat' => r['mat'], 'notes' => [] }
          c['qty'] += r['qty']
          c['codes'] << r['code'] unless r['code'].to_s.empty? || c['codes'].include?(r['code'])
          c['modules'] << r['module'] unless c['modules'].include?(r['module'])
          r['note'].to_s.split('; ').each { |n| c['notes'] << n unless n.empty? || c['notes'].include?(n) }
        end
        groups = {}
        rows.each_value do |c|
          gk = by_t ? [c['mat'], c['T']] : [c['mat']]
          g = groups[gk] ||= { 'mat' => c['mat'], 'T' => by_t ? c['T'] : nil, 'rows' => [], 'pieces' => 0, 'm2' => 0.0 }
          g['rows'] << c.merge('note' => c['notes'].join('; ')).reject { |k, _| k == 'notes' }
          g['pieces'] += c['qty']
          g['m2'] += c['qty'] * c['L'].to_f * c['W'].to_f / 1e6
        end
        groups.values.sort_by { |g| [g['mat'].to_s, g['T'].to_f] }.map do |g|
          g['rows'] = g['rows'].each_with_index.sort_by { |c, i| [-c['T'].to_f, c['part'].to_s, -c['L'].to_f, -c['W'].to_f, i] }.map(&:first)
          g['m2'] = g['m2'].round(2)
          g['title'] = by_t ? "#{g['mat']} · #{fmt g['T']} mm" : g['mat'].to_s
          g['sub'] = "#{g['pieces']} #{I18n.t(g['pieces'] == 1 ? 'piece' : 'pieces', lng)} · #{g['m2']} m²"
          g
        end
      end

      def self.csv_cell(v)
        s = v.to_s
        s =~ /[",\n;]/ ? '"' + s.gsub('"', '""') + '"' : s
      end

      def self.to_csv(data)
        t = ->(x) { I18n.t(x, data['lang'] || 'en') }
        x = ->(v) { v ? 'X' : '' }
        out = []
        out << [t.('Code'), t.('Module'), t.('Panel'), t.('Qty'), t.('Length (grain) mm'), t.('Width mm'), t.('Thickness mm'),
                'L1', 'L2', 'W1', 'W2', t.('Material'), t.('Notes')]
        data['rows'].each do |r|
          e = r['edges']
          out << [r['code'], r['module'], r['part'], r['qty'], fmt(r['L']), fmt(r['W']), fmt(r['T']),
                  x.(e['L1']), x.(e['L2']), x.(e['W1']), x.(e['W2']), r['mat'], r['note']]
        end
        out << []
        out << [t.('HARDWARE'), t.('Qty')]
        data['hardware'].each { |h| out << [h['item'], h['qty']] }
        out << []
        out << [t.('EDGE BANDING (material)'), t.('Metres')]
        data['banding'].each { |b| out << [b['mat'], b['m']] }
        out << []
        out << [t.('SHEET ESTIMATE (material)'), t.('Thickness'), 'm²', t.('Sheet size'), t.('Sheets incl. 15% waste')]
        data['sheets'].each { |s| out << [s['mat'], fmt(s['T']), s['m2'], s['size'], s['sheets']] }
        out.map { |row| row.map { |c| csv_cell(c) }.join(',') }.join("\r\n") + "\r\n"
      end
    end
  end
end
